about: Written for Creek's tests, not part of the reconstruction. 'markers' is what the model could have written in its resolve/ask markers under the Creek protocol, using only what was known when each branch settled (the reconstruction has resolutions but no rules or tags). 'probes' are representative edits at each lost detail's later_msg: 'first touch' is the edit made before anyone knew the detail mattered, 'fix' is the edit that repaired it. Probes are guesses at what those edits contained; the real diffs are not in the fixture.

b1.rule: the nav must fit at 1024 and 1280 px; recheck header width across every view when adding nav links

b2.rule: the help panel is a modal <dialog> in the browser's top layer; anything drawn over the page (overlays, a custom pointer) must check for an open dialog

b3.rule: the typing plays once per tab: sessionStorage 'hero-typed' is set only when typing completes; clear it to replay

b4.rule: about lines carry no full stops; the meta description joins them with '. '

b5.rule: contact keys return early on key repeat or an open dialog, before the key is marked handled

b6.rule: contact links handle keys first and preventDefault matched ones; the header skips keys with e.defaultPrevented

b7.rule: claim a matched contact key first, then skip the action if it is a repeat or help is open

b8.rule: the help panel groups keys under # anywhere / # on projects / # on contact, one per line; new shortcuts go in the right group

b9.rule: useDigitFlash is shared by the ticker and the stats bars

b10.rule: round SVG coordinates computed from time or trig to 3 decimals so server and browser output match

b12.rule: set bylineLang on a byline that is not in English

b13.ask: Which key should 'more' use? m is taken by 'me'; it is o for now

b14.rule: only the four flavour names redirect; /projects/* also serves images

b16.ask: For the landing bullets, did you want // or # (the bash comment marker)? I used #

b18.rule: the crosshair re-reads its target on scroll and caches its text; corner tags stay clamped inside the viewport

b19.rule: the custom pointer is shelved (PR #42 is a draft); don't rebuild it without asking
b19.table: too big; it hid the real information

b20.ask: Which entry counts as the year 1 design project, and is there a link for the paper?

b21.rule: only entries with a website get the big card; entries without one need the 'when' field
